verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API (v2) exposes bookings, event types, schedules, and webhooks, and the MIT-licensed Cal.diy fork plus self-hosting option (with own DB per cal-com-comm-12) give a path to full data ownership rather than lock-in — supporting an 'export and leave' capability indirectly. However, there is no documented dedicated data-export feature (e.g., bulk export to CSV/JSON) and community reports dispute how independent self-hosting really is, with claims you 'can't self-host the API' and must pay to use it (cal-com-comm-3), and Docker images being restricted/removed for the OSS edition (cal-com-comm-14, cal-com-comm-19). Missing for 10: an explicit bulk data-export tool/format, clear confirmation that self-hosted instances are fully independent of hosted API, and resolution of the docker-image/self-host restriction disputes.
